voiceover:
[conversational] Stop chasing action items through email and final_v3 spreadsheets.

[curious] Free AI can turn messy notes into a tracker in 3 steps. Stay till the end, because one step stops it quietly guessing wrong.

Step 1: open Gemini or ChatGPT, and paste your notes with this: "Extract every action item into a table: Task, Owner, Due date, Priority, Status. Write TBD if missing." Include the meeting date, so Friday becomes a real date.

Step 2: check the table. Step 3: Gemini has Export to Sheets, bottom right. ChatGPT? Copy the table, click A1 in Sheets, paste.

[confident] One-column mess? Ask for CSV in a code block, then Data, Split text to columns.

[amused] Honest catch: it's a plain sheet, so no reminders. Remove sensitive names first.

[serious] Now, that step is step 2. AI can guess owners, dates and priorities, so read every row and fix mistakes in chat.

[playful] What's the messiest tracker your team uses? Send this to the friend who still emails final_v3.

Hack saved?

pick.topic: Turn messy meeting notes into a tracker of action items (owner, due date, priority) in 3 steps, using a free AI and Google Sheets or Excel
pick.tool: ChatGPT or Gemini (free) + Google Sheets or Excel
pick.angle: Stop chasing action items over email and 'final_v3' spreadsheets. Paste your notes into AI, get a ready table, and paste it into Sheets.
pick.why: 503k views and 3,401 comments, the top comment-to-view ratio among the practical office tutorials. Everyone who sits in meetings has the problem. The original needs paid M365 Copilot, so our free-tool version reaches more people.

research.tool: ChatGPT (Free) or Gemini app (Free) to build the action-item table, then Google Sheets or Excel. Gemini has an 'Export to Sheets' button on tables. The popular reel is about a different tool: the 'SharePoint list agent' in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
research.availability: Free: ChatGPT Free and the Gemini app with a personal Google account both cost $0, on web and phone. Sheets/Excel also work. The reel's Copilot route needs a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot license, so it is not free. Gemini's 'Export to Sheets' needs a Google account and works best on desktop.
steps: Open chatgpt.com or gemini.google.com (signed in, free account) and start a new chat.

Paste your raw meeting notes with a prompt like: 'Extract every action item from these notes into a table with columns: Task | Owner | Due date | Priority (High/Medium/Low) | Status. Write TBD if owner or date is missing. Meeting date is [date], so convert words like Friday into real dates (YYYY-MM-DD).'
Check the table the AI returns. Fix any wrong owner, date or priority by replying in chat.
Gemini: click 'Export to Sheets' at the bottom right of the table. It saves the table as a new spreadsheet in Google Drive, and you click Open Sheets.
ChatGPT: copy the table (the table's Copy control if shown, or select the whole table). In Google Sheets or Excel, click cell A1 and paste with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V.
If everything lands in one column, ask the AI to 'output as CSV in a code block'. Paste it into A1 and use Data > Split text to columns. Or paste into a .txt file and rename it to .csv.
Share the sheet with your team: Share button, top-right of Google Sheets.
facts: Gemini help page: the 'Export to Sheets' button is at the bottom right of the table and saves the table in a new spreadsheet in Google Drive (support.google.com/gemini/answer/14184041).
Export to Sheets only appears for responses that contain a table, and tables with images can't be exported (same Google help page).
Export to Sheets always creates a new spreadsheet; it does not insert into an existing sheet (aitxtformatter.com). To add to an existing sheet, copy and paste, or use File > Import > Upload.

ChatGPT free: OpenAI's help page (updated within the last week) says Free and Go users have unlimited everyday text chats, subject to abuse-prevention safeguards. File uploads, image generation, voice, data analysis and other tools have separate limits (help.openai.com/en/articles/20001354).
PCWorld and Engadget (about 90 days old): OpenAI removed text-chat rate limits for Free/Go and made GPT-5.6 Luna the default Free model. Older '10 messages every 5 hours' articles are outdated.
A third-party summary of OpenAI's upload article says the Free plan allows 3 file uploads a day (runelab.ai, 3 Nov 2026). This is not confirmed first-hand, so verify before quoting.
Gemini free: $0 with a Google account, compute-based limits that refresh every 5 hours up to a weekly limit (dapta.ai).
Gemini app context window: 32K tokens with no AI plan, 128K on Google AI Plus, 1 million on AI Pro and Ultra (geotoolbox.ai, datastudios.org, citing Google's help page).
Since Oct 9, 2026 Gemini's free tier is limited to the Flash-Lite model (aipricecompare.org, techjacksolutions.com).
Gemini paid plans: AI Plus $4.99/mo, AI Pro $19.99/mo (costbench.com, datastudios.org).

Gemini built into Google Sheets (the 'Ask Gemini' side panel) is a paid / Workspace feature, not part of the free app. Free users should use the Gemini app plus Export to Sheets (tech.yahoo.com, techjacksolutions.com).
Pasting a ChatGPT/Gemini markdown table can collapse into one cell. Copying the rendered table, or using CSV/TSV, usually fixes it (backrun.co, dev.to, thebricks.com).
Excel option: Gemini has no Excel export. Export to Sheets first, then File > Download > Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) (note.com guide).

SharePoint list agent (the reel's actual tool): Microsoft 365 Copilot license required. It is on by default for orgs with Copilot, can be disabled by admins, and works in Copilot Chat, Teams, Outlook and Word (supersimple365.com, topedia.com).
SharePoint list agent is not available in Excel. It can only create new lists, including initial rows, and cannot update existing ones (blog-en.topedia.com).

SharePoint list agent previews the proposed columns and sample rows before the list is finalized (hubsite365 summary of the Microsoft 365 demo). So the reel's 'review before it's created' claim is supported.
do_not_claim: Do not present the SharePoint list agent / Microsoft 365 Copilot route as free. It needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot license (the reel's caption cuts off at 'You need a Mic...').
Do not say 'live list your whole team can edit, filter and open in Teams' for our Sheets/Excel method. That is the SharePoint feature. Sheets is shared via Share, and Excel via OneDrive/SharePoint.
Do not say ChatGPT free is limited to '10 messages per 5 hours'. That is outdated for text chat as of Aug 2026.
Do not say Gemini free gives you the Pro/Flash model or 'Gemini 3'. Free accounts are on Flash-Lite since Oct 9, 2026.
Do not promise one-click export for ChatGPT. Only Gemini has 'Export to Sheets'. ChatGPT needs copy and paste, and its UI table-copy button is described inconsistently across sources.
Do not say the AI is always accurate. Owners, dates and priorities may be guessed, so the user must review them. This is general knowledge, not tied to a specific source.
Do not claim the 'Gemini in Sheets' side panel is free.
The reel's 'works for expense requests, vendor lists, hiring pipelines' is marketing. No source verifies it.
criticism: Free Gemini has a 32K-token context window, so very long notes or transcripts may be cut off or need splitting.
ChatGPT free caps file uploads and attachments (limits reported at about 3 uploads a day). Pasting text into the chat avoids this.
The free ChatGPT tier shows ads to US users since Feb 2026 (techjacksolutions.com, secondary source).
Gemini 'Export to Sheets' can be missing on work or school Google accounts if an admin or the Workspace extension setting turns it off (note.com guide).
Pasting a markdown table can collapse into one column and needs cleanup (aiifi.ai, backrun.co).

Privacy (no source checked): pasting confidential meeting notes into a consumer AI chat deserves a caution. The writer should say 'remove sensitive names/info' rather than make specific claims about data use.
A plain Sheets/Excel tracker is not a 'live' workflow tool. It has no reminders or automatic assignments, and the AI doesn't keep it updated.

ui.platforms: Web (desktop) is best. Phone apps for ChatGPT, Gemini and Sheets exist, but 'Export to Sheets' and table copy are easier on desktop.
screens: UI details below come from general knowledge, not search results. Check against a live screen before recreating them.

ChatGPT web: left sidebar with 'New chat', chat history and the profile name at bottom-left. A large centered message box at the bottom with a '+' attach button and send button, and the prompt text 'Ask anything'. Replies render as a real table with header row, and hovering the table shows a copy control. Default theme follows the system, usually light.

Gemini web: left collapsible menu with 'New chat' and 'My Stuff' / recent chats. A centered greeting such as 'Hello, [name]' and a rounded 'Ask Gemini' box with '+' and a model picker. A table in the reply has an 'Export to Sheets' button at the bottom-right corner of the table (per Google's help page). Clicking it shows an 'Open Sheets' link. Default is light, following the system.

Google Sheets web: a blank spreadsheet with menu bar 'File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Data, Tools, Extensions, Help', a green 'Share' button top-right, and A1 selected. After pasting you should see 5 columns: Task, Owner, Due date, Priority, Status. For a cleaner look, bold the header row and add a dropdown for Priority.
If the paste lands in one column: Data menu > 'Split text to columns', then choose the separator.
Excel: Home tab > Paste, with A1 selected and the same table result. Use 'Paste Special' / 'Match Destination Formatting' to remove web styling (itechtips.blog).

research.visuals: Show the messy pasted notes, then the AI's clean 5-column table (Task, Owner, Due date, Priority, Status). Then show Sheets with the same table in A1:E?. A real screen recording is best for the 'Export to Sheets' click on Gemini or for the Ctrl+V paste. A mock-up of the final sheet will do for the result.
research.notes: Our topic works, but it is a different workflow from the popular reel, so don't copy its claims. The reel is about the paid SharePoint list agent. Ours uses free AI plus Sheets/Excel. Free-tier details changed a lot in 2026: ChatGPT text chat became unlimited in Aug 2026, and Gemini free moved to Flash-Lite only on Oct 9, 2026. Avoid naming specific model versions or message counts on screen. Say 'free ChatGPT or Gemini'. Gemini is the only one with a one-click 'Export to Sheets', so lead with Gemini for the 3-step flow: 1 paste notes + prompt, 2 check the table, 3 Export to Sheets or copy-paste. Give ChatGPT users the copy-paste route. Tell viewers to give the meeting date in the prompt so 'by Friday' becomes a real date. For Excel users, Export to Sheets then download .xlsx, or paste directly into A1. Verify the ChatGPT UI labels (copy icon placement) on a live screen before recreating them.
